m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You examine this hydraulic channeler, it uses the type of fuses installed in the Water-Matons. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You install the fuses into the hydraulic channeler, but the power is still only half what it should be. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You should also check the hydraulic channeler on the far side of the reactor!  </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You examine the hydraulic channeler, but realize it needs a new set of fuses like those used by the Aqua-Bots. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You install the second set of fuses into the hydraulic channeler, restoring the telluric flow to the gate control.</ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Now you can use the gate control to get access into the Crystal Reactor! </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You throw the switch, and can immediately hear the gate unlock at the entrance to the Crystal Reactor! </ITALICS>
Who you be?! You not welcome down here! My fish-bots weak, but Maglump no weak! Maglump strong!
<ITALICS>As Maglump is defeated, he drops a piece of the portal to the Solarium. </ITALICS>
What a strange little creature, eh? I wonder... who, or what, set him up to such deviltry?
While ye were hittin’ the books, I did some studyin’ of me own. I believe I know where hides our mysterious foe!
The pathing rotes on their cogitator circuits spell it out that they’re originating in the Crystal Reactor.
The Crystal Reactor is in the next dome over from this one, a locked tower at the heart of all the Celestian power array!
The books ye read told ye how to open the gates ta that tower. Now ye must go there and confront this baddie and give ‘em what-for!
Have ye been to the Crystal Reactor yet? ‘Tis time to venture forth and face this mysterious foe!
